messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Acme Health sent a security/compliance questionnaire asking for SOC2 artifacts, HIPAA controls, audit log retention, and details on private deployments. They want answers by next Friday. attaching the PDF: https://files.redwood/acme-hipaa-q1.pdf

Samir Patel: I pulled the questionnaire into support. main asks: 1) encryption at rest + KMS/HSM details 2) audit log retention + schema 3) data processing addendum + subprocessors 4) option for VPC/on-prem / customer-managed keys. they also asked for sample audit logs format.

Maya Chen: tagging @Olivia Zhang and @Luis Ortega — we need a product/security triage. recommended priority: P0 for HIPAA-sensitive customers but confirm. :eyes:

Olivia Zhang: We can provide SOC2 Type II summary, control mappings, and encryption details. Constraints: hosted API currently exposes tenant metadata in logs for routing; we can redact PII and provide an export view for customers. retention: default 90 days for request-level logs, 1 year for audit trails with legal hold option. KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS in Private and Dedicated; hosted can support CMK via our KMS integration but needs legal review. SIEM forwarding via syslog/HTTPS is doable.

Priya Nair: Customer is explicitly asking for "audit logs including who accessed which model + prompt snippets" — we need to confirm whether prompt content is included in audit logs by default. 

Samir Patel: Current prod: request metadata + model, route, token counts, and a hashed user id are logged. prompt text is not persisted in full in long-term audit logs (we keep it ephemeral for debugging unless flagged). we can create an opt-in export that includes prompt text for customers under DPA/HIPAA but that is a policy + storage cost change.

Luis Ortega: Proposal for triage -> Product backlog: create intake ticket with these fields: customer, compliance scope (HIPAA + SOC2), required artifacts, desired retention windows, deployment preference (hosted/dedicated/private), acceptance criteria, legal sign-off checklist, and ETA. Suggested priority: P1 with 3-week SLAs for initial artifact pack, P0 only if they threaten to pause pilot.

Maya Chen: Draft acceptance criteria (first pass):
```
- Provide SOC2 summary + management response (PDF)
- Provide control mapping matrix for HIPAA (table)
- Audit log export: schema + sample for 1 year retention option
- Confirm encryption at rest + KMS options and steps to enable CMK
- Document DPA & subprocessors draft for legal
- Implementation plan if customer requests prompt retention (opt-in): storage cost estimate + retention toggle
```

Olivia Zhang: +1. Also add: SIEM integration docs, retention purge workflow, and RBAC/SSO evidence (SAML/OIDC screenshots). We should list any unsupported asks clearly (e.g., full on-prem appliance is out of scope this quarter).

Priya Nair: for backlog grooming — can we get an engineer owner for the audit-log-export schema and an eng-security owner for controls mapping? I can take coordination w/solutions eng and sales.

Samir Patel: I'll open the intake ticket in JIRA: INF-4521. I'll attach the questionnaire and our initial answers draft. tagging @Luis Ortega for acceptance criteria and @Olivia Zhang for security artifacts.

Maya Chen: timeline decision: aim to deliver initial artifact pack in 10 business days, and a scoped implementation plan for prompt-retention in 3 weeks. if legal needs more time we'll push.

Olivia Zhang: We'll need the following from Acme to complete: (1) list of PHI classes they consider sensitive, (2) any regulatory specifics beyond HIPAA, (3) whether they will use Dedicated or Private. Ask sales to get that ASAP.

Luis Ortega: I'll add a launch checklist to the JIRA ticket with roll-forward criteria: docs approved by security, legal sign-off on DPA, implementation steps for retention toggle, and testing runbook. Also add monitoring: token-level cost estimate and latency impact.

questionnaire-bot: PDF uploaded: acme-hipaa-q1.pdf (uploaded by Samir Patel)

Maya Chen: Great — next steps: Samir to create ticket (done), Sales to get missing customer inputs, Olivia + Security to draft artifacts, Product to write acceptance criteria and set priority. I'll run a follow-up sync in 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
